notes.title: 4 years later, a new game approaches!
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing: Alien Extraction!
[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1768730/Alien_Extraction/

[h2]Thanks you RacetronicVR players[/h2]

4 years after the wierd, wonderful and occasionally stomach turning RacetronicVR released, I'm working on a brand spanking new VR game. I released RacetronicVR for free as a experimental game, working out that VR racing is a bit stomach turning but a good laugh. This time I am pouring my heart and soul into Alien Extraction, making the best experience I can. Thank you soo much again for trying out RacetronicVR and if your still into VR I hope you'll wishlist Alien Extraction today!
